verdict.rationale: Simular documents an open-source framework for computer-control agents (simular-docs-4). Sai also supports BYOD, so users can download it and run it on their own Mac or Windows devices (simular-docs-20). However, the flagship Sai experience is described as running in Simular's cloud VMs (simular-docs-23, simular-docs-1), and nothing shows the backend or orchestration can be fully self-hosted. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting docs for the core Sai service/backend, deployment instructions, independent or hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted setup.
